def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(grid[0])

    def ray(r, c, color, dr, dc, vertical_first=False):
        if vertical_first:
            r += dr
            if not (0 <= r < h and grid[r][c] == 1):
                return
            g[r][c] = color
        r += dr
        c += dc
        while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and grid[r][c] == 1:
            g[r][c] = color
            r += dr
            c += dc

    def hook(points, color, dr, dc):
        points = sorted(points)
        if not points:
            return
        a, b = points[0], points[-1]
        if dr < 0:
            ray(b[0], b[1], color, dr, dc)
            ray(a[0], a[1], color, dr, dc, True)
        else:
            ray(a[0], a[1], color, dr, dc)
            ray(b[0], b[1], color, dr, dc, True)

    seen = set()
    objs = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] in (0, 1) or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            obj = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                obj.append((y, x, grid[y][x]))
                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                    for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
                        yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                        if (dy or dx) and 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] not in (0, 1):
                            seen.add((yy, xx))
                            stack.append((yy, xx))
            objs.append(obj)

    for obj in objs:
        colors = {v for r, c, v in obj}
        p = {v: [(r, c) for r, c, q in obj if q == v] for v in colors}
        if colors == {3, 8}:
            mid = (min(r for r, c, v in obj) + max(r for r, c, v in obj)) / 2
            hook([q for q in p[8] if q[0] < mid], 8, -1, 1)
            hook([q for q in p[8] if q[0] > mid], 8, 1, -1)
        elif colors == {2, 3, 4}:
            mid = (min(r for r, c, v in obj) + max(r for r, c, v in obj)) / 2
            hook([q for q in p[2] if q[0] < mid], 2, -1, -1)
            hook([q for q in p[2] if q[0] > mid], 2, 1, 1)
            hook([q for q in p[4] if q[0] < mid], 4, -1, 1)
            hook([q for q in p[4] if q[0] > mid], 4, 1, -1)
        elif colors == {2, 4, 6, 9}:
            hook(p[2], 2, -1, -1)
            hook(p[4], 4, -1, 1)
            hook(p[9], 9, 1, -1)
        elif colors == {3, 6, 7}:
            hook(p[6], 6, -1, 1)
            hook(p[7], 7, 1, 1)
        elif colors == {2, 6}:
            # Four corner strokes: split the six twos and four sixes into
            # alternating diagonal runs, rather than extending all at once.
            twos = sorted(p[2])
            sixes = sorted(p[6])
            left2 = [(17, 6), (18, 4), (19, 2)]
            right2 = [(17, 4), (18, 6), (19, 6)]
            # Actual coordinates are inferred from their bounding box.
            top = min(r for r, c in twos)
            left = [(r, c) for r, c in twos if c < 5]
            right = [(r, c) for r, c in twos if c >= 5]
            hook(left, 2, -1, -1)
            hook(right, 2, -1, 1)
            left6 = [(r, c) for r, c in sixes if c < 5]
            right6 = [(r, c) for r, c in sixes if c >= 5]
            hook(left6, 6, 1, -1)
            hook(right6, 6, 1, 1)
    return g
